gloss: Koshien (baseball stadium); the national high school baseball tournament

definitions.gloss: Koshien Stadium; the national high school baseball tournament held there
definitions.explanation: Hanshin Koshien Stadium in Nishinomiya, Hyogo Prefecture. Home of the Hanshin Tigers professional baseball team and, more importantly in cultural terms, the venue for Japan's national high school baseball tournaments. By extension, 甲子園 often refers to the tournaments themselves, which are a major cultural event.

examples.japanese: {甲子園|こうしえん}を{目指|めざ}す。
{今年|ことし}の{夏|なつ}の{甲子園|こうしえん}は{熱戦|ねっせん}が{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: There were many intense games at this summer's Koshien tournament.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}{時代|じだい}、{甲子園|こうしえん}に{出場|しゅつじょう}するのが{夢|ゆめ}だった。
examples.english: When I was in high school, my dream was to compete at Koshien.

notes:
Hanshin Koshien Stadium ({阪神甲子園球場|はんしんこうしえんきゅうじょう}) is one of Japan's most iconic sports venues. It hosts two major high school baseball tournaments each year: the {選抜|せんばつ}{高等学校|こうとうがっこう}{野球|やきゅう}{大会|たいかい} (Spring Invitational, commonly called {春|はる}の{甲子園|こうしえん}) and the {全国|ぜんこく}{高等学校|こうとうがっこう}{野球|やきゅう}{選手権|せんしゅけん}{大会|たいかい} (Summer Championship, {夏|なつ}の{甲子園|こうしえん}). These tournaments are a cultural phenomenon, broadcast nationally, and the word {甲子園|こうしえん} itself symbolizes youthful aspiration and dedication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甲子園|こうしえん}を{目指|めざ}す: to aim for Koshien (goal of high school baseball players)
- {甲子園|こうしえん}に{出場|しゅつじょう}する: to compete at Koshien
- {夏|なつ}の{甲子園|こうしえん}: the Summer Koshien tournament
- {春|はる}の{甲子園|こうしえん}: the Spring Koshien tournament
- {甲子園|こうしえん}{球場|きゅうじょう}: Koshien Stadium

CULTURAL NOTE:
The word {甲子園|こうしえん} has become metaphorical — other competitions for young people are sometimes called 「○○の{甲子園|こうしえん}」 (the Koshien of XX), meaning the pinnacle competition in that field.
